about: Morden is a city in Manitoba’s Pembina Valley, west of Winkler and north of the U.S. border, in rolling prairie at the Manitoba Escarpment. The Canadian Fossil Discovery Centre, the Corn and Apple Festival, and a walkable downtown define this regional service city. About 10,000 people live in Morden.
seoSummary: Pembina Valley city west of Winkler—fossil museum, Corn and Apple Festival, and prairie service centre.
